audit.why: Level chart reads Skill, Akali, Akali, Skill, Skill, Akali, Akali on both layers and matches audits/top/akali__singed.json, which proposed no chart change. The singed packet suggests a Singed-favoured chart, but the mirror is authority and I did not fight it.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; flagged for the user in notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is described as her spike because 'Insanity Potion's healing' cannot catch up, and the shroud timer is given as a flat 18 seconds.
audit.why: Insanity Potion has no heal in Riot's text — it grants combat stats and puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16, so 18s is only rank 3; at 6 she is usually on rank 1-2, i.e. 20-19s. Perfect Execution is 120/90/60 and its second cast executes on missing health.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in: Twilight Shroud 20s at rank 1, Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1, Mega Adhesive 17s, Fling 10s, Insanity Potion 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate strings say Mega Adhesive roots Akali when she tries to leave the goo (wants.you[1], mid, whys[2]). It does not. Riot's text: Mega Adhesive slows and GROUNDS; the root only exists when Fling drops the target into the adhesive. The grounding — which switches Shuriken Flip's re-cast dash and both casts of Perfect Execution off — is stated nowhere, and it is the whole matchup.
audit.why: Singed W: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it'. Singed E: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Akali E and R are both dashes; grounded, neither fires. Twilight Shroud making her 'unable to be selected by enemy spells' is why Fling, a targeted 125-range ability, cannot be cast on her inside it — this half was right and I kept it.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated, the fake exit-root replaced with the real Fling-into-adhesive root, and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Perfect Execution's second cast is described only as 'burst'.
audit.why: It executes on missing health, so the threat is a threshold, not a health bar you can eyeball — and Insanity Potion's stats raise the threshold you need to stay above.

edits.after: Build MR — proxy + kite her. Mega Adhesive grounds Shuriken Flip and her R dash both.

edits.before: From levels 4 through 5 this lane is genuinely contested and you should not force a 1v1 while Insanity Potion is on cooldown and Rylai's is unbuilt. Proxy under or behind her tower when the wave is in her half of the lane, and use Mega Adhesive to root her at the edge of her dash range when she tries to punish you — she cannot exit the goo zone without triggering the root. Level 6 flips temporarily in her favour: her two-part R lets her engage and disengage faster than you can poison-kite, and Twilight Shroud straight up negates a Fling. Take your R and survive the spike, matching her only when shroud is on cooldown. The shroud timer is 18 seconds — count it.
edits.after: From levels 4 through 5 this lane is genuinely contested and you should not force a 1v1 while Insanity Potion is on cooldown and Rylai's is unbuilt. Proxy under or behind her tower when the wave is in her half, and put Mega Adhesive (17s) on the ground she wants to land on — grounded, the Shuriken Flip re-cast will not fire, and a Fling that drops her in the goo roots her outright. Level 6 flips temporarily in her favour: Perfect Execution is a 120s two-part leap whose second cast executes on missing health, and Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable, so a targeted Fling cannot be cast at all. Take your R and survive the spike, matching her only when the shroud is down — 20 seconds at rank 1. Count it.

edits.before: Once Rylai's is built every walk through your Poison Trail becomes a persistent slow and she cannot juke in and out of the cloud the way she could at level 6. Fling her into the slowed zone, drop Mega Adhesive on her escape path, and Insanity Potion's movement speed means you keep pace with her dashes in a way that should not be physically possible. Split-push adjacent towers: she is an assassin, not a siege champ, and she cannot match your tower-clearing speed under pressure. At two items her burst is real — if she has Hextech Rocketbelt and a second AP item, do not take the 1v1, just proxy and let the map work for you.
edits.after: Once Rylai's is built every walk through your Poison Trail becomes a persistent slow and she cannot juke in and out of the cloud the way she could at level 6. Fling her into the slowed zone, drop Mega Adhesive on her escape path so the grounding kills the Shuriken Flip re-cast, and Insanity Potion keeps your pace on her dashes while its Grievous Wounds cuts whatever omnivamp she bought. Split-push adjacent towers: she is an assassin, not a siege champ, and she cannot match your tower-clearing speed under pressure. At two items her burst is real — if she has Hextech Rocketbelt and a second AP item, do not take the 1v1, just proxy and let the map work for you.
